input.subject: [E30] Duplicate Payment
input.body: Dear Team, I was charged twice while ordering an Xbox Wireless Controller, but only one order was placed successfully. My first payment was made using a different bank account, and I then placed the order successfully using another account. The order ID is BM189438. I would like to request a refund for the first transaction. Please check the duplicate payment and let me know when I can expect the refund.

resolver.draft:
Hi Manish,

Thank you for reaching out to ByteMart support.

Re: [PENDING APPROVAL] Duplicate Payment for Order #BM189438

We have received your request regarding the duplicate payment for your Xbox Wireless Controller. Our team will review the payment details and initiate the refund process for the first transaction. Please allow us 3-7 business days for the refund to be processed back to your original payment method.

Best regards,
ByteMart Customer Support
resolver.reasoning: The customer has requested a refund for a duplicate payment, which triggers a HILT action. The order is confirmed, and the refund process requires operator approval as per the refund policy.

hilt_reason.reason_long: The customer has reported being charged twice for a single order, which necessitates a review and approval process for the refund.
